name: 暗黑之侵略者
desc: 只要这张卡在场上表侧表示存在，对方不能把速攻魔法卡发动。
faq: "Invader of Darkness" prevents the activation of Quick-Play Spell Cards, but doesn't negate their effects. So if your opponent activates a Quick-Play Spell Card and you chain "Call of the Haunted" to Special Summon "Invader of Darkness", he does not negate the activation or effect of the Quick-Play Spell Card.
